title: How Many Rooks to BEAT Stockfish?
summary: Tony plays Stockfish 17 (depth 35) as White. Game 1 is a normal even game (loses). Each subsequent game one White pawn is replaced by an extra rook (first the h2 pawn). With 2 extra rooks he wins, finishing with a ladder mate after promoting.
rules: Normal chess rules; full standard armies for both sides.
After each loss, replace one more of White's pawns with a rook (h2 first, then the next pawn) and replay.
Opponent is Stockfish 17 at depth 35 (maximum strength).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish; the challenge ends at the first win (took 2 extra rooks).
